common.loadFailed: The projects could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

list.title: Projects
list.subtitle: Planned changes, improvements and design work, with their milestones, team, reviews and lessons learned.
list.timelineEmpty: None of these projects has a start or due date yet, so there is nothing to draw.
list.noMatchClosedHidden: Closed projects are hidden by the status filter. Reset the filters to see them all.

fields.title: Title
fields.healthHint: The owner's view of how the project is going: green, amber or red.
fields.objectiveEvidence: What shows the objective was met

form.teamHint: Add the people who will work on the project. You become a manager automatically as the owner, and you can change the team later.
form.changeReasonHint: Saved in the revision history so others can see why the project changed.
form.readOnly: You can view this project but not edit it. The owner, a team manager or a project administrator can.
form.closedReadOnly: This project is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
form.assistBody: Describe the project in a sentence or two and the assistant drafts a title, objective, scope and dates. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

errors.dueBeforeStart: The due date cannot be before the start date.
errors.summary: Could not save. Fix the highlighted fields.

form.changeIntro: When the project changes how the organisation works, plan the change: what could go wrong, what is needed, and what it affects.
form.affectedPlaceholder: Search for a process or a document
form.objectivesPlaceholder: Search for an objective or a KPI
form.relatedOnDetail: Add affected processes, documents and objectives on the project page under Overview.
form.securityChecklistHint: The project page gives you a checklist: risk assessment, DPIA, supplier security and security test.

detail.noSecurityReqs: No information security requirements written down yet.
detail.closedNotice: This project is {{ status }} (closed on {{ date }} by {{ name }}). It is read-only; lessons learned can still be added.
detail.deleteMessage: {{ code }} is removed together with its milestones, design reviews and lessons, and its open tasks are cancelled. The audit trail is kept.

basis.milestones: The percentage is the share of phases and milestones that are done (cancelled ones do not count).
basis.tasks: The project has no milestones, so the percentage is the share of tasks that are done.
basis.completed: The project was closed as completed.
basis.none: Nothing is planned yet. Add milestones or tasks to measure progress.

plan.title: Plan
plan.empty: Nothing is scheduled yet. Add phases and milestones with dates, or tasks with due dates, to see the plan.

board.empty: Tasks on the project and its milestones show here, sorted by status.
board.moveFailed: The task could not be moved. Check that you may edit it and try again.

milestones.title: Phases and milestones
milestones.empty: No phases or milestones yet. Split the work into phases, and mark the points where something must be finished or decided as milestones.
milestones.deleteMessage: "{{ title }}" is removed from the plan. Its open tasks are cancelled.

reviews.title: Design reviews, verification and validation
reviews.empty: No reviews recorded yet. Plan a review at each important stage, and record verification (does the output meet the input requirements?) and validation (does it work for the intended use?).
reviews.noMilestone: Not tied to a phase or milestone
reviews.needsDate: Give the date the review was held before recording an outcome.
reviews.deleteMessage: "{{ title }}" is removed. The audit trail is kept.
reviews.revisionOnSave: The current revision is pinned when you save
reviews.decisionHint: When you choose a result and save, you are recorded as the one who decided.
reviews.actionsHint: Turn each agreed action into a task. Open actions must be done before the project can be closed as completed.

lessons.title: Lessons learned
lessons.empty: No lessons recorded yet. Note what went well and what should be done differently next time, while it is fresh.
lessons.connectPlaceholder: Search for a task, risk, deviation or document

team.title: Team
team.removeMessage: {{ name }} is removed from the project team. Their tasks stay assigned to them.

closeout.title: Close {{ code }}
closeout.subtitle: Record how the project ended and what you learned.

outcomeHints.completed: The objective was reached. Every milestone, design review and task must be finished first.
outcomeHints.cancelled: The project is stopped. Open tasks are cancelled.

closeout.openItems: The project still has open work: {{ milestones }} milestones, {{ reviews }} pending design reviews and {{ tasks }} open tasks. Finish or cancel them, or close the project as cancelled.
closeout.lessonsHint: Lessons without a title are skipped. You can add more after closing.
closeout.noObjective: The project has no objective written down.
closeout.blocked: The project cannot be closed as completed yet, because it still has open work:
closeout.evidencePlaceholder: For example: measurements, test reports or feedback.
closeout.approverHint: The person who accepts the result, for example the sponsor or a manager. Optional.
closeout.missingObjective: Answer whether the objective was met.

reopen.title: Reopen {{ code }}?
reopen.message: The project becomes active again and can be edited. Say why it is reopened; the reason is kept in the history.

ai.title: AI help
ai.intro: Get a status summary for a steering group, or prompts for risks the project may face. Check the output before you use it.
ai.checkNote: Generated from the project's records. Check it before you share it.
ai.taskFailed: The task could not be added.
ai.risksNote: Suggestions only. "Register in the risk register" opens the risk form filled in, and the risk is linked to the project when you save.

ask.summarise: Summarise this project: where it stands, what is late and what needs a decision.
ask.objective: Help me write a clear, measurable objective for this project.
ask.objectiveReview: Is this project objective clear and measurable? Suggest improvements.
ask.securityRequirements: Which information security requirements should this project consider (ISO 27001 A.5.8)?
ask.findings: Help me write clear findings and actions for this design review.
ask.draft: Help me set up a new project. Ask me what it is about, then draft it for me to confirm.
ask.label: Ask about the project
ask.consequences: What consequences and risks should I consider for this change, and which processes could be affected?
ask.review: Summarise the review "{{ title }}": what was found, which actions came out of it, and have they been followed up?

notices.lessonTask: The improvement action is created and linked to the lesson.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that on this project.
errors.notFound: The project was not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.closeout_summary_required: Write a close-out summary before closing the project as completed.
errors.invalid_dates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.invalid_department: That department does not exist in this organisation.
errors.invalid_fields: Some fields could not be saved.
errors.invalid_phase: Choose a phase of this project (phases cannot contain phases).
errors.invalid_sort: That sort order is not valid.
errors.invalid_status: That status is not allowed here.
errors.module_disabled: Projects are turned off for this organisation.
errors.owner_is_manager: The project owner is always a manager. Change the owner first.
errors.project_closed: The project is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
errors.project_has_open_items: The project still has open milestones, design reviews or tasks.
errors.user_not_member: That person is not a member of this organisation.
errors.linkFailed: Could not link the record. Check that you can access it and try again.
errors.invalid_document: The document does not exist, or you cannot access it.
errors.invalid_revision: That revision of the document does not exist.
errors.invalid_objective_met: Answer yes, partly or no to whether the objective was met.
errors.unsupported_entity_type: This kind of record cannot be linked here.

notifications.created: New project for you: {{ code }} {{ title }}
notifications.ownerChanged: You now own the project {{ code }}: {{ title }}
notifications.memberAdded: You were added to the project {{ code }}: {{ title }}
notifications.memberRemoved: You were removed from the project {{ code }}: {{ title }}
notifications.designReviewCreated: Design review planned in {{ code }}: {{ review_title }}
notifications.designReviewDecided: Design review decided in {{ code }}: {{ review_title }}
notifications.designReviewUpdated: Design review updated in {{ code }}: {{ review_title }}
notifications.designReviewDeleted: Design review deleted from {{ code }}: {{ review_title }}

security.title: Information security in the project
security.intro: ISO 27001 requires information security to be part of the project. The checklist fills in as you connect the right records to the project.

hints.risk_assessment: Link or create a risk for the project.
hints.dpia: Needed when the project processes personal data with high risk.
hints.supplier_security: Link the suppliers the project uses, with a supplier evaluation.
hints.security_test: Plan a verification or validation under Reviews and record that it passed.

outputs.title: Design outputs
outputs.intro: The documents the project delivers: specifications, drawings, user guides. They are controlled like other documents.
outputs.changesHint: Design changes are recorded as reviews of the type "Design change".
